invariant: Concurrent product runtimes wait through ordinary transient SQLite writer contention and reserve distinct durable command ordinals.

original.finding_source: manual Bug discovery workflow run 34663371138, receipt mutation shards 1, 2, 3, and 7
original.independent_reproducer: four independent fresh hosted checkouts plus the owning regression applied to the original production source
original.failure_signature: reservation completed while writer lock held: Ok(Err("reserve durable command ordinal: database is locked"))

fault_schedule: open a fresh or initialized ordinal database
retain the writer lock for 500 ms
required_reachability: second reservation waits while the writer lock is held
reopen observes the next distinct ordinal
reproducer.oracle: bounded wait result and the next durable ordinal after reopening the database
reproducer.minimization: one database, one held immediate transaction, one competing reservation, and one reopen; removing any step loses contention or durability evidence

fix.root_cause: the allocator replaced rusqlite's five-second default busy timeout with 250 ms, shorter than ordinary concurrent durable writer scheduling

fixed_replay.expected: exit 0 for both fresh and initialized databases; the waiting reservation and reopened allocator return consecutive distinct ordinals

negative_control: with no competing writer, reservation remains immediate; restoring the 250 ms timeout makes the held-writer regression fail before lock release
cleanup: the hosted failures use fresh ephemeral runners; the owner regression uses temporary directories and commits the held transaction before scope exit
limitations: contention beyond five seconds remains an explicit error
the fix does not mask permanently stalled or externally locked databases
